source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

intelligence.enrichment: All living beings are made up of cells. A cell is the basic unit of life because one cell can be a whole unicellular organism, and many cells can build a multicellular organism. Cells as basic building blocks -> one or many cells form living organisms -> organism functions become possible. The learner correctly applies this rule: All living beings are made up of cells. A cell is the basic unit of life because one cell can be a whole unicellular organism, and many cells can build a multicellular organism. Only large plants and animals are made of cells; tiny bacteria are just specks, not cell-based organisms.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 8 Science question. Chapter: Microorganisms: friend and foe. The student must decide: Decide whether a living organism should be understood as being built from cells, whether it has one cell or many cells. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options). Two-tier (choose, then reason) is welcome: put A/B/C on part.options, not typed into part text.
